15-min break after this. Then we start AGENTS.
Takes a question, returns an answer, done.
Takes a goal, DECIDES what to do, ACTS, OBSERVES,
User → LLM → Tool → LLM → Tool → LLM → User
A chatbot answers. An agent acts.
one task: 'Is Mumbai hotter than yesterday?'
2. I need to compare with yesterday
LLM replies with no tool call → done
Loop ends when the LLM decides to reply (no tool call) or hits max_iterations.
You send: system prompt + user question + list of TOOL
LLM responds with a JSON object:
Your Python code reads the JSON, calls the ACTUAL
Your code sends the result BACK to the LLM as a "tool"
LLM uses the result to write the final answer
This handshake is the whole mechanism. Memorize it.
Use for attendance rules, exam structure,
description — WHEN to use this. The LLM
parameter descriptions — treat the LLM like
a smart intern reading your API doc
Vague description = wrong tool call. Spend time here.
Agentic RAG = your retriever is just one tool among many.
PDF, web, DB, API — each is just a tool the agent can choose.
Build an agent with 2 tools (45 min) + what's next
